about: The owner asks to check that every one of their inputs is stored as a file, then write system/docs/inputs-vision.md: a detailed overview of the project from all their inputs, without repeated or overruled logic, divided by scope (system agent, common file rules and so on), in ASD-STE100 style.
changes_when: Never in the owner's words; only its answer and what it was processed into are added once its knowledge is placed.

update_with.how: Keep its row (summary, categories, processed_into, answered) the same as this file.
